name: Gmina Mieścisko (Poland, until 2025)
description: Divided by a curved line into a red hoist part and a white fly part, the white charged with the gmina arms in the upper fly.
history: The earlier flag of the gmina; replaced on 24 June 2025 (resolution No. XVIII/100/2025) by a vertical bicolour of light blue and red with the charge from the arms, designed by Gerard Kucharski.

features.role: divided by a curved line, red at the hoist and white at the fly
